blocks.runs: The 2016 competition will take place on Saturday 22nd October at St Sepulchre-without-Newgate. The judges are Linda Garton, John Loveless, and Simon Read.

The welcome and draw will take place at 10:30, and photographs of the bands will be taken immediately afterwards. The first band will ring at 11:00. Ringing will finish at 14:30, with results in the Butcher's Hook and Cleaver at around 15:30.
The pub for the day is the Butchers Hook and Cleaver, on W Smithfield. It will be open from 11:00, serving four real ales and food.
The test piece is 6 leads of Cambridge Surprise Maximus, finishing with a twelfths place lead end. All of the rows of the touch and the first row of rounds at the end will be judged.
The bands taking part in this year's competition are:

items: Ancient Society of College Youths (2 bands)
Middlesex County Association and London Diocesan Guild
University of London Society of Change Ringers
